column1: 30701§pillar§ˈpɪlə§n. 柱子；立柱；支柱；中坚（人物）§At five-thirty the old Panhandle bridge, supported by massive sandstone pillars, stalwart, as when erected fifty years before to serve a generation now passed behind the portals of life, had become a spectral outline against the sky.§五点半时，那座由巨大**砂岩柱**支撑的老潘汉德尔桥依旧如五十年前初建时那般坚固，在天空下只剩一道幽灵般的轮廓——它当年是为一代人而建，而那一代人如今已跨过生命之门。§He gestured to the lamassus [sculptures] and pillars surrounding us.§他指了指我们四周的拉玛苏（神兽雕像）与**石柱**。§§a pillar of the community 社会的中坚§§

30702§erosion§ɪˈrəʊʒn§n. 侵蚀；腐蚀；（权利、价值的）逐渐削弱§Adelaide, Australia, has installed engineered structures along 53% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from wave erosion and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening.§澳大利亚阿德莱德在 53% 的海岸线上修建了工程结构，以保护基础设施免受波浪**侵蚀**及其它危害，这种做法被称为海岸硬化。§For example, the tree roots would have greatly reduced soil erosion, and the accumulated twigs the trees shed likely created new habitats for animal life.§例如，树木根系本可大幅减少土壤**侵蚀**，落下的枯枝也本可能为动物创造新的栖息地。§§wave erosion 波浪侵蚀；soil erosion 土壤侵蚀；erode v. 侵蚀；削弱§§

30703§derivative§dɪˈrɪvətɪv§adj. 模仿的；缺乏原创的；派生的 n. 衍生物；派生物；衍生品§Mimesis is typically translated as “imitation” in modern editions of ancient Greek texts, but scholar Stephen Halliwell warns that this is overly reductive: “imitation” implies that art merely copies—and is thus by definition entirely derivative of—a reality that exists outside and prior to the work of art, and translating “mimesis” thusly obscures the multifaceted ways in which the ancient Greeks understood the relationship between art and reality.§mimesis 在古希腊文献的现代版本中通常译为「模仿」（imitation），但学者 Stephen Halliwell 提醒说，这过于简化：「模仿」暗示艺术只是复制，因而在定义上完全**派生自**作品之外、先于作品存在的现实；这样翻译会遮蔽古希腊人理解艺术与现实关系时的多重面向。§Dong Liu et al. investigated the fracture toughness (both the initiation and propagation toughness) of the HEA CrMnFeCoNi and its MEA derivative CrCoNi and concluded that the alloys’ toughness performance differs from that of most HEAs and MEAs.§Dong Liu 等人研究了高熵合金 CrMnFeCoNi 及其中熵合金**衍生物** CrCoNi 的断裂韧性（包括起裂韧性与扩展韧性），得出结论：这两种合金的韧性表现不同于大多数高熵合金与中熵合金。§§derivative of 派生自…；模仿…的；derive v. 源自；获得§艺术评论中含贬义，指「模仿他人的、缺乏原创的」；金融语境指「衍生品」§改译文：原译把 mimesis 写成「摹仿」、imitation 留英文，原词与译词颠倒了；补译文2

30704§resonance§ˈrezənəns§n. 共鸣；（情感上的）感染力；共振；回响§Her approach adds powerful resonance to films that explore the highly personal experiences of place and home, and often the difficult decision to stay or leave.§她的处理方式为那些探讨地方与家园的切身经验、以及「留下还是离开」这一艰难抉择的影片，增添了强烈的**共鸣**。§It is the link of shared humanity with the artists across so many centuries that gives the Lascaux Cave paintings such resonance.§正是与跨越许多世纪的艺术家之间共享的人性纽带，赋予了拉斯科洞穴壁画如此深长的**共鸣**。§§add resonance to 为…增添共鸣；resonant adj. 引起共鸣的；回响的§物理学中指「共振」§

30705§monastery§ˈmɒnəstri§n. 修道院；寺院§Most infamously, he participated in what was essentially a private war against Sempringham Priory, a monastery near his manor, even making off with 500 pounds' worth of monastery property during a raid.§最为人诟病的是，他参与了一场实质上针对森普林厄姆小修道院的私战——那是他庄园附近的一座**修道院**——甚至在一次袭击中掠走了价值 500 英镑的修道院财产。§§§§§与 priory（小修道院）、abbey（大修道院）层级不同§

30706§formidable§ˈfɔːmɪdəbl§adj. 令人敬畏的；高超的；强大的；难以对付的§Although he is indebted to the European tradition of figurative painting, with its proportionality of human form and depth between foreground and background, Anishinaabe painter Daniel Ashkewe uses his formidable technique to portray—and thereby ensure the transmission of—cultural traditions predating the European colonization of the lands of his tribe.§尽管他受惠于欧洲具象绘画传统——那种讲究人体比例与前景背景纵深感的传统——阿尼什纳贝画家 Daniel Ashkewe 却以**令人叹服的**技术描绘了早于欧洲殖民其部族土地的种种文化传统，并借此确保它们得以传承。§§§§formidable technique 令人叹服的技艺§既可形容对手「难对付」，也可形容能力「高超得令人敬畏」§

30707§novelty§ˈnɒvlti§n. 新奇；新颖；新奇的事物§Adam, seeing that the old man was interested in the novelty of the ship, suggested that he should stay the night on board, and that he would himself be ready to start at any hour and go anywhere that the other suggested.§亚当见老人对这艘船的**新奇**之处颇感兴趣，便提议他在船上过夜，并说自己随时都准备出发，去对方想去的任何地方。§After you have stayed a week and the bloom of novelty has rubbed off you wonder if you can accommodate yourself to the peculiar conditions.§住满一周、**新奇**的光泽磨掉之后，你就会开始怀疑自己能否适应这里的种种特殊境况。§§the bloom of novelty 新鲜感；novel adj. 新颖的§§

30708§earnest§ˈɜːnɪst§adj. 认真的；真诚的；诚挚的§For instance, Perry contends that some of Waugh’s earliest works, notably his biography of artist Dante Gabriel Rossetti, exhibit the earnest romanticism that would characterize Waugh’s later fiction.§例如，Perry 主张：Waugh 最早的一些作品——尤其是他为画家 Dante Gabriel Rossetti 所作的传记——已展现出那种日后成为其小说特征的**真挚**浪漫主义。§§§§in earnest 认真地；earnestly adv. 恳切地（very earnestly wish 恳切地希望）§与人名 Ernest 同音§

30709§suppress§səˈpres§v. 压制；镇压；抑制（情绪、免疫反应等）§Eliminating tariffs can lead to an influx of cheaper imported goods, lowering prices; in a place where domestic production is relatively expensive, this influx can suppress domestic production, as the country’s consumers favor more cheaply produced imported goods over domestically produced ones.§取消关税可能导致更便宜的进口商品大量涌入，从而压低价格；在国内生产成本相对较高的地方，这种大量涌入会**压制**国内生产，因为该国消费者更青睐价格更低的进口商品，而非本国产品。§As observed in a 2011 study by Emilio García-Robledo and Alfonso Corzo, macroalgal proliferation may have a suppressive effect on the abundance of cyanobacteria and other microphytobenthos (MPB)—chlorophyll-producing microbes inhabiting marine sediment—in part by reducing the amount of sunlight available to MPB.§正如 Emilio García-Robledo 与 Alfonso Corzo 在 2011 年的一项研究中所观察到的，大型藻类的激增可能对蓝细菌及其他微型底栖植物（MPB，栖居于海洋沉积物中、能产生叶绿素的微生物）的丰度产生**抑制**作用，部分原因是减少了 MPB 可获得的阳光。§§suppress domestic production 压制国内生产；suppression n. 压制；抑制；suppressive adj. 抑制性的§§改译文：原译漏译分号前的前半句（取消关税、价格下降、国内生产成本高）；补译文2

30710§congestion§kənˈdʒestʃən§n. 拥堵；拥挤；（医）充血§In a college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that traffic congestion in the United States increased between 1990 and 2000 mostly in and around very large cities such as Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.§在一门城市事务课程中，一名学生断言，1990 至 2000 年间，美国的交通**拥堵**主要发生在费城等特大城市及其周边。§In response to this challenge and others, such as the increasing congestion of roadways, delivery companies are continually looking for ways to make last-mile delivery more efficient.§为应对这一挑战及道路日益**拥堵**等其他难题，快递公司不断寻找让末端配送更高效的办法。§§traffic congestion 交通拥堵；congest v. 使堵塞§§原书错：引申义写成「充血的」，congestion 是名词，应为「充血」

30711§veil§veɪl§n. 面纱；遮蔽物 v. 遮掩；掩饰§And like a spirit, swathed in some soft veil, Steals twilight and its shadow's o'er the swale.§而黄昏像个幽灵，裹在一层轻柔的**面纱**里，携着它的影子悄悄爬过那片低洼的草地。§§§§veiled adj. 含蓄的；隐晦的（veiled criticism 含蓄的批评）§§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（veil,Steals）；改译文：原译是整首诗的翻译，只留对应这两行的部分

30712§advent§ˈædvent§n. 出现；到来；（Advent）基督降临节§The advent of online streaming has led many music listeners to drift away from ownership of music (through downloads or through physical media such as compact discs) in favor of the streaming services YouTube Music and AccuRadio, among others.§在线流媒体的**出现**，使许多音乐听众不再追求「拥有」音乐（通过下载或光盘等实体媒介），转而使用 YouTube Music、Accu Radio 等流媒体服务。§§§§§比 appearance 更强调「划时代的到来」；大写 Advent 指基督降临节§改例句：You Tube、Accu Radio 是专名被拆开，合为 YouTube、AccuRadio

30713§vibrant§ˈvaɪbrənt§adj. 鲜艳的；明亮的；充满活力的；生机勃勃的§As juveniles, all white-necked jacobin hummingbirds display vibrantly blue head plumage; when they enter adulthood, males retain these blue feathers and most females molt to a drab green hue.§所有白颈雅各宾蜂鸟在幼年时都长着**亮蓝色**的头部羽毛；进入成年后，雄性保留这些蓝色羽毛，而多数雌性则换羽为暗哑的绿色。§Chemists investigating the properties of coal tar in the mid-nineteenth century discovered compounds that led to the creation of vibrant artificial colorants.§十九世纪中叶研究煤焦油性质的化学家发现了一些化合物，催生了**鲜艳**的人工色素。§§vibrantly adv. 鲜艳地；vibrancy n. 活力；鲜艳§§

30714§activism§ˈæktɪvɪzəm§n. 行动主义；（社会、政治）积极行动；激进主义§Imani Jacqueline Brown is an artist who blends scientific research, political activism, and various media in her work.§伊玛尼·杰奎琳·布朗是一位艺术家，她的创作融合了科学研究、政治**行动主义**与多种媒介。§§§active 积极的 → activism§political activism 政治行动主义；environmental activism 环保行动；activist n. 活动家§§

30715§defect§ˈdiːfekt§n. 缺陷；缺点；毛病 v. 叛逃；背叛§This information is necessary so that the electrician can begin figuring out whether the continued outage is caused by a defective device or simply by too many devices running at the same time.§这条信息是必要的，这样电工才能开始判断持续的停电是由某个**有缺陷的**设备造成的，还是仅仅因为同时运行的设备太多。§§§§defective adj. 有缺陷的（defective device 有缺陷的设备，真题用此形）§与 flaw 近义；动词 defect 意为「叛逃」，重音后移读 dɪˈfekt§改译文：原译是另一句（缺陷部分可补救）的翻译，按英文重译

30716§efficacy§ˈefɪkəsi§n. 功效；效力；有效性§Researchers used anonymized location data from the US and Côte d’Ivoire to document people’s daily patterns of mobility, using these results to test the efficacy of the researchers’ predictive computer model.§研究者使用来自美国与科特迪瓦的匿名位置数据，记录人们日常的出行模式，并用这些结果检验其预测性计算机模型的**效力**。§The workshop advised mariners to avoid orcas pending further testing of the efficacy of TAST, a harmless acoustic deterrent.§研讨会建议船员在进一步验证无害声学威慑装置 TAST 的**效力**之前，避让虎鲸。§§test the efficacy of 检验…的效力；efficacious adj. 有效的§与 efficiency（效率）不同：efficacy 问「有没有用」，efficiency 问「省不省」§

30717§theatrical§θiˈætrɪkl§adj. 戏剧的；剧场的；舞台的；夸张做作的§In a research paper about theatrical costume design, a student argues that costume designers for modern productions of Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream (set in ancient Greece) sometimes include such elements unintentionally.§在一篇关于**戏剧**服装设计的论文中，一名学生主张，为莎士比亚《仲夏夜之梦》（背景设定在古希腊）的现代演出设计服装的设计师，有时会无意间纳入这类元素。§§§§theatrical costume design 戏剧服装设计；a theatrical gesture 做作的姿态§§

30718§strand§strænd§v. 使搁浅；使困住 n. 股；缕；（论述的）线索§The significance to investors of the potential for stranding is evident, and companies ought to disclose such risks to them, but it is no less important to ensure that when unsustainable companies involved in petroleum distribution cease operations, those companies' employees are assisted in their transitions to other jobs.§资产**搁浅**的可能性对投资者的重要性显而易见，企业应当向他们披露此类风险；但同样重要的是，要确保当参与石油销售的不可持续企业停止运营时，这些企业的员工能在转岗中获得帮助。§Wang and colleagues excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through—an essential step He and colleagues’ study did not take.§Wang 及同事用屏障隔开各株植物的根系、只放行菌根**菌丝**，从而排除了菌根网络之外的一切路径——这是 He 等人的研究未采取的关键步骤。§§stranded adj. 搁浅的；被困的（stranded assets 搁浅资产）；mycorrhizal strands 菌根菌丝§§改例句2：删去混入的「Text 2」标签及 Text 2 首句，译文2 相应删去

30719§staple§ˈsteɪpl§n. 主食；主要产品；订书钉；（门闩的）扣鼻 adj. 主要的；基本的§Kwakwaka'wakw song keeper Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla aided research by ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al. by contributing songs that reference creating terraced intertidal gardens to foster the healthy development of clams, a staple in the Kwakwaka'wakw people's diet.§夸夸嘉夸族的歌者 Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla 为民族生物学家 Dana Lepofsky 等人的研究提供了帮助，贡献了提到修建潮间带梯田式园圃、以促进蛤蜊健康生长的歌曲——蛤蜊是该族饮食中的**主食**。§Signs of his incompetence were evident on his front door: the nameplate hung crookedly, and the hasp didn’t quite meet its staple.§他不称职的迹象在自家前门就可见一斑：铭牌挂歪了，搭扣与**扣鼻**也没对齐。§§a staple in one’s diet …饮食中的主食；staple crops 主要作物§另有「订书钉；（门闩的）扣鼻」义，例句2 hasp…staple 即此义§

30720§pulp§pʌlp§n. 果肉；浆状物；纸浆；低俗通俗作品§Recent advancements in ohmic heating were made through research in Brazil on the preservation of acerola pulp.§欧姆加热技术近来的进展，来自巴西关于针叶樱桃**果浆**保存的研究。§§§§acerola pulp 针叶樱桃果浆；pulp fiction 低俗小说§§

30721§durable§ˈdjʊərəbl§adj. 耐用的；持久的；耐久的§She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).§她把这一假说与海螺对卡卢萨人（Calusa）的高价值联系起来——既作为食物，也作为建筑材料（海螺壳非常**耐用**）。§Being coarser than Merino wool overall, Navajo-Churro wool yields a more durable yarn, which Diné (Navajo) weavers use in their celebrated rugs.§纳瓦霍-丘罗羊毛整体比美利奴羊毛粗，纺出的纱线更**耐用**，迪内（纳瓦霍）织工正是用它织出著名的地毯。§§durable goods 耐用品；durability n. 耐用性§与 lasting 近义§

30722§emerging economies§ɪˈmɜːdʒɪŋ ɪˈkɒnəmiz§n. 新兴经济体（快速增长的发展中国家或地区）§Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997.§为考察羊群效应是否也发生在各国的经济政策层面，Maru Etta-Nkwelle 研究了 1997 年金融危机全面爆发后数年间，世界各地区**新兴经济体**（emerging economies）的外汇储备变动。§§§§emerging technologies 新兴技术；emerging field 新兴领域；economies of East Asia 东亚各经济体；economies of scale 规模经济§economy 作「经济体」可数，复数指多个国家或地区，作「节约」不可数；economic 经济上的 ≠ economical 节约的§原书错：「规模经济」通常作复数 economies of scale，不是单数 economy of scale

30723§rigorous§ˈrɪɡərəs§adj. 严谨的；严格的；严密的§Economist Thomas Piketty’s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology.§经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂的《二十一世纪资本论》结构比其续作《资本与意识形态》更为**严谨**。§§§§rigor n. 严格；严谨；严酷；rigorously adv. 严格地§多为褒义，指结构、论证、方法严谨§

30724§trait§treɪt§n. 特征；特点；（遗传）性状§They claim that the historical mischaracterization of birdsong as a male trait is largely the result of bias: much of the research ornithologists have carried out has been near universities in the temperate northern hemisphere, where female birdsong is less common than it is in the tropics.§他们主张，把鸟鸣历史性地误认为雄性**特征**，很大程度上是偏见的产物：鸟类学家开展的许多研究都在北半球温带的大学附近进行，而那里的雌鸟鸣叫远不如热带常见。§Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group.§研究者对「此类噪声如何影响动物」的研究做了一项元分析，发现每项研究中暴露组与条件相似但未暴露的对照组相比，动物的相关**性状**或行为都存在可观察的差异。§§a male trait 雄性特征；personality traits 性格特征§遗传学、心理学常用；与 characteristic 近义但更偏「可遗传、可测量」§

30725§invasive§ɪnˈveɪsɪv§adj. 入侵的；侵入性的；（医）有创的§However, like many highly specialized species, the kiwikiu is particularly vulnerable to environmental stressors, such as disease, invasive species, and habitat destruction, that disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystems in which the birds live.§然而，像许多高度特化的物种一样，kiwikiu 特别容易受到环境压力的冲击，例如疾病、**入侵**物种与栖息地破坏——这些都会扰乱鸟类所赖以生存的精细平衡的生态系统。§But researchers Alejandro Camacho and Jason McLachlan have pointed out that "invasive" and "native" are labels that describe temporary circumstances.§但研究者 Alejandro Camacho 与 Jason McLachlan 指出：「**入侵**」与「本土」只是描述暂时状态的标签。§§invasive species 入侵物种；invasive surgery 有创手术；invade v. 入侵；invasion n. 入侵§§原书错：invasive surgery 是「有创手术」，原书写成「微创/侵入性手术」，微创是 minimally invasive；改例句2：Mc Lachlan 是姓氏被拆开，合为 McLachlan，译文2 同改

30726§realism§ˈrɪəlɪzəm§n. 现实主义；写实主义；务实作风§Scholars cite The Kingdom of This World, the 1949 novel by Cuban author Alejo Carpentier, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.§学者们把古巴作家阿莱霍·卡彭铁尔 1949 年的小说《这个世界的王国》视为魔幻**现实主义**的奠基之作——这一拉美小说风格在原本属于现代小说典型的写实再现模式中，嵌入了反现实的叙事手法（多借自美洲原住民与殖民社会的民间传说传统）。§This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name Is Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Turkey.§这一风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性影响，其中包括奥尔罕·帕慕克——他 2001 年的《我的名字叫红》把文学**现实主义**与民间传说（即土耳其的民俗）并置，酷似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。§§magical realism 魔幻现实主义（拉美文学标志性流派）；realistic adj. 现实的；逼真的；realist n. 现实主义者§与 romanticism（浪漫主义）相对§改例句：foundational test 应为 text，Lation 应为 Latin；改译文：「奠基性试验」随之改为「奠基之作」；改例句2：ls 应为 Is，folklore 后漏破折号

30727§baseline§ˈbeɪslaɪn§n. 基线；基准；（用于比较的）初始值§Persad and her colleagues concluded that concentration of precipitation into fewer events would result in a higher number of dry days, triggering more irrigation, but that this change in irrigation output is highly sensitive to the baseline concentration of precipitation that currently exists in an area.§Persad 及其同事得出结论：降水集中于更少的几次降水事件会使干旱日数增加，从而引发更多灌溉；但灌溉量的这一变化对某地区目前已有的**基线**降水集中度高度敏感。§§§§baseline data 基线数据；pretraining baselines 训练前的基线§§改译文：原译是另一句（研究文献缺陷）的翻译，按英文重译

30728§chronicle§ˈkrɒnɪkl§n. 编年史；（按时间顺序的）记述 v. 按时间顺序记载；记录§Edmund Morris, noted for his three-volume chronicle of the life of Theodore Roosevelt, completed Edison, his biography of Thomas Edison, in 2019.§以记述西奥多·罗斯福生平的三卷本**编年史**闻名的埃德蒙·莫里斯，于 2019 年完成了他那部托马斯·爱迪生传记《Edison》。§Siemowit appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118.§谢莫维特见于《波兰君公事迹》——一部写于 1112 至 1118 年间的中世纪波兰**编年史**。§§chronicle the decline 记录衰落过程；chronological adj. 按时间顺序的§§改译文：原译把 chronicle 译成「传记」，与后文 biography 混同，改为「编年史」

30729§fracture§ˈfræktʃə§v. （使）断裂；（使）破裂；（使）分裂 n. 断裂；骨折；裂缝§Researchers investigated the timing of the transition from a stagnant lid regime to a tectonic plate regime, in which the lithosphere is fractured into dynamic plates that in turn allow lithospheric and mantle material to mix.§研究者考察了从「停滞盖层」体制向「板块构造」体制转变的时间——在后者中，岩石圈**断裂**成动态的板块，从而使岩石圈物质与地幔物质得以混合。§HEAs and MEAs are known for withstanding cracking at extremely low (cryogenic) temperatures relatively well, though their fracture toughness generally falls as temperature does.§高熵合金与中熵合金以在极低（低温）温度下相对不易开裂著称，尽管其**断裂**韧性通常随温度下降而降低。§§be fractured into 断裂成…；fracture toughness 断裂韧性；fractured adj. 断裂的；分裂的§§

30730§captive§ˈkæptɪv§adj. 被圈养的；被俘的；被控制的 n. 俘虏；被监禁者§Among studies of nonhuman primates, James Welles's 1976 study of captive chimpanzees and catarrhine monkeys reported more right-handed individuals than left-handed ones, but William C.§在非人灵长类研究中，James Welles 1976 年对**圈养**黑猩猩与狭鼻猴的研究报告称，右利手的个体多于左利手，但 William C.……§§§§captive chimpanzees 圈养的黑猩猩；captive audience 不得不听（看）的受众；captivity n. 圈养；囚禁§§

30731§magistrate§ˈmædʒɪstreɪt§n. 地方法官；治安法官；司法官§A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme court in Finland and the Supreme Court in the Dominican republic.§一份来自某国际组织的报告，监测了各国最高法院（如芬兰最高法院与多米尼加共和国最高法院）中担任法官或**司法官**的女性人数。§§§§§英国指基层治安法官，美国指较低审级的司法官员；有些国家最高法院的成员也称 magistrates§改译文：最高法院里的 magistrates 不是「地方法官」，改为「司法官」

30732§milestone§ˈmaɪlstəʊn§n. 里程碑；重大事件；转折点；里程标石§Known for the albums Someday My Prince Will Come and Milestones, jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated several times with pianist Gil Evans.§爵士小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯以《Someday My Prince Will Come》与《Milestones》（意为「**里程碑**」）等专辑闻名，曾多次与钢琴家 Gil Evans 合作。§§§§§本义是路边的里程标石，引申为「标志性事件、重大节点」；例句中是 Miles Davis 的专辑名§改译文：专辑名后补注中文义，以便标出本词

30733§municipality§mjuːˌnɪsɪˈpæləti§n. 自治市；市镇；市政当局§Huazalingo is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.§瓦萨林戈（Huazalingo）是墨西哥伊达尔戈州的一个**市镇**。§In 2015, geologist Peter Rogerson calculated that the geographic center of Oklahoma was a point 4.4 miles south of the municipality of Edmond.§2015 年，地质学家 Peter Rogerson 计算出俄克拉何马州的地理中心位于**埃德蒙市**以南 4.4 英里处。§municipal 市政的 → municipality§municipal government 市政府§§改译文：原译是另一句（波多黎各阿蒂约市）的翻译，按英文重译

30734§spontaneous§spɒnˈteɪniəs§adj. 自发的；自然的；不由自主的；即兴的§Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter's instruction to laugh.§来自 21 个社会（包括奥地利与土耳其）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自两名女性自然对话中的**自发**笑声，以及另外 18 名女性按实验者指令发出的有意笑声。§When classical pianist Martha Argerich performs, it appears as if the music is coming to her spontaneously.§古典钢琴家玛塔·阿格里奇演奏时，音乐仿佛是自她心中**即兴**涌现。§§spontaneously adv. 自发地；spontaneity n. 自发性§与 volitional（有意的）对照§

30735§friction§ˈfrɪkʃn§n. 摩擦；摩擦力；（人际、组织间的）冲突；阻力§One reason is that exact prices may create greater cognitive friction during purchase decisions than do whole-number prices or prices easily rounded to whole numbers (e.g., $5.99, which is little different from $6).§原因之一是：与整数价格或易于取整的价格（例如 5.99 美元，与 6 美元相差无几）相比，精确价格在购买决策中可能带来更大的认知**摩擦**。§Using carbon nanotubes and oil, Jun Qu and colleagues at a US Department of Energy lab have created a coating for moving parts that reduces friction to the point where it is almost nonexistent.§Jun Qu 及其美国能源部实验室的同事利用碳纳米管和油，为运动部件研制出一种涂层，把**摩擦**减低到几乎不复存在。§§cognitive friction 认知摩擦；reduce friction 减少摩擦；frictional adj. 摩擦的§§原书错：frictional 标成「动词」，实为形容词

30736§foliage§ˈfəʊliɪdʒ§n. （植物的）叶子；叶丛；簇叶§Conversely, Myrmotherula guttata (the rufous-bellied antwren), with which M. fusca shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging.§相反，Myrmotherula guttata（红腹蚁鸟）——在法属圭亚那与 M. fusca 共享领地——采用「**叶面**拾取」（从叶片上啄食昆虫）的方式觅食，这大大限制了该鸟觅食时的视野。§The wood I walk in on this mild May day, with the young yellow-brown foliage of the oaks between me and the blue sky, the white star-flowers and the blue-eyed speedwell and the ground ivy at my feet, is one of those happy spots where the soul may sit and hold silent converse with itself.§在这个温和的五月天，我漫步林中，头顶与蓝天之间是橡树新生的黄褐色**叶丛**，脚下是白色的星形花、蓝眼睛似的婆婆纳和连钱草；这片树林正是那种灵魂可以静坐、与自己默默交谈的幸福之地。§§foliage gleaning 叶面拾取（鸟类从叶面啄食昆虫的觅食方式）§§补译文2

30737§marginal§ˈmɑːdʒɪnl§adj. 微小的；边缘的；次要的；页边的§In some domestic breeds, such as the Spanish Merino, the outer fiber is only marginally coarser than the inner, and the wool is soft overall.§在一些家养品种中，例如西班牙美利奴羊，外层纤维只比内层**略粗**一些，羊毛整体柔软。§Support for the argument that a "consumer revolution," in which possession of consumer goods among an increasingly wide range of socioeconomic groups surged despite only marginal wage growth, occurred in England between 1600 and 1750 has largely hinged on scholars' analyses of probate inventories (detailed legal records of deceased persons' possessions).§对「1600 至 1750 年间英格兰发生过一场『消费革命』——工资仅**微涨**而拥有消费品的社会群体却大为拓宽」这一论点的支持，主要系于学者对遗嘱财产清单（对逝者财产的详细法律记录）的分析。§§marginal notes 页边批注；marginal change 微小变化；marginally adv. 略微；稍微§§改例句2：识别错字十余处（onsumer rewohlutiom、ofconsumer、sociceconomic goups、growith、oecurred、Engand、1750has、scholars 缺撇号、peobate inventorles、detalled、ofdeceased、possesions），按原意改正并补右引号；改译文2：句首补「对」

30738§seigniorage§ˈseɪnjərɪdʒ§n. 铸币税；铸币利差（货币面值超出生产成本的利润）§… Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage—profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it …§……发行一美元硬币可产生正**铸币税**——即硬币面值超过其单位生产成本时所产生的利润……§§§§positive seigniorage 正铸币税§经济学术语，指政府凭铸币权获得的收入§改音标：英式读 ˈseɪnjərɪdʒ，原标 siːnˈjɔːrɪdʒ 不对；改译文：删去英文没有的「供新加坡政府用于交通等公共服务」，补上首尾省略号

30739§onset§ˈɒnset§n. 开始；发作；（疾病、季节等的）来临§Some geologists have proposed designating the period from 1950 to the present as a new geological epoch (the Anthropocene) characterized by human impact on Earth, but they have struggled to identify reliable stratigraphic markers of the epoch’s onset.§一些地质学家提议把 1950 年至今定为一个新的地质世元（人类世），以人类对地球的影响为特征，但他们一直难以找到该世元**起始**的可靠地层标志。§Researchers tested the hypothesis by examining a population of broadleaf arrowhead, a plant for which bloom onset generally takes longer for male flowers than for female flowers, during the flowering season.§研究者在花期考察了一个阔叶慈姑种群以检验该假说——这种植物的雄花通常比雌花需要更长时间才**开始**开花。§§the onset of …的开始；…的发作；bloom onset 开花起始§常指疾病、季节、时期的「发作、来临」；与 outset 近义§改译文2：原译漏了 onset（开花起始所需时间）和 during the flowering season

30740§feasible§ˈfiːzəbl§adj. 可行的；行得通的；可实现的§While rebuilding an HZ’s physical structure (e.g., with gravel) might be feasible, is it possible to restore its biological community?§重建一个 HZ 的物理结构（例如用砾石）也许**可行**，但能否恢复其生物群落呢？§Assuming a scenario in which 10% coverage of currently eligible land by such infrastructure is feasible …§假设目前可用土地中 10% 用于此类基础设施是**可行**的……§§feasibility n. 可行性§与 possible 不同：feasible 强调「在资源、条件下可实现」§

30741§empathy§ˈempəθi§n. 共情；同理心；移情§There is a growing belief that teaching medical students about art alongside standard science and clinical coursework helps them become more observant, develop greater patient empathy, and strengthen their communication skills.§越来越多的人相信，在标准理科与临床课程之外，同时教医学生艺术，有助于他们变得更善于观察、培养更强的患者**共情**，并增强沟通能力。§§§§patient empathy 对患者的共情；empathize v. 共情；empathetic adj. 有同理心的§与 sympathy（同情）不同：empathy 是「设身处地」，sympathy 是「为之难过」§

30742§prose§prəʊz§n. 散文；（与韵文相对的）白话文；文笔§For example, it is true that the prose in his novel Foundation is quite plain—we are often given only the faintest ideas of what people, objects, and settings look like.§例如，他小说《基地》中的**散文笔法**确实相当平实——我们往往只能得到关于人物、物体与场景的最模糊的印象。§His prose is workmanlike: his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions.§他的**文笔**只是工匠水平：人物扁平，谈的是观念而非情感。§§prose poem 散文诗§与 verse（韵文）相对；prosaic 是「平淡乏味的」§

30743§specimen§ˈspesɪmən§n. 标本；样本；样品；（化验用的）试样§To measure changes in parasite abundance over time, Chelsea Wood and colleagues counted parasite individuals preserved on specimens of Pacific herring, spotted ratfish, and six other fish species collected from Puget Sound between 1880 and 2019.§为测量寄生虫丰度随时间的变化，Chelsea Wood 及同事清点了保存在太平洋鲱、斑点鼠鱼等八种鱼类**标本**上的寄生虫个体——这些标本于 1880 至 2019 年间采自普吉特湾。§Michael G. Campana and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate the evolutionary origins of a fungal pathogen affecting bats.§Michael G. Campana 及同事依赖历史 DNA——偶然保存于自然史馆藏**标本**中的基因组数据——来研究一种侵害蝙蝠的真菌病原体的演化起源。§§§医学语境指「化验样本」；与 sample 相比更强调「个体样本」§

30744§ensemble§ɒnˈsɒmbl§n. （音乐、戏剧）团体；剧团；乐团；合奏；整体§Steve Carter’s award-winning play Eden was produced in 1976 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC).§Steve Carter 的获奖剧作《伊甸园》（Eden）于 1976 年由具有开创意义的黑人**剧团**（Negro Ensemble Company，NEC）制作。§Steiger Butte Drum, a family ensemble from the Klamath Tribes of the Pacific Northwest, collaborated with composer Michael Gordon to create Natural History, a work featuring traditional drumming and vocals alongside an orchestra and chorus.§来自西北太平洋克拉马斯部落的家族**鼓乐团** Steiger Butte Drum 与作曲家 Michael Gordon 合作创作了《自然史》——一部以传统鼓乐与人声，联袂管弦乐团与合唱团的作品。§§an ensemble cast 群像阵容§音乐中也指「合奏（曲）」§

30745§proxy§ˈprɒksi§n. 替代指标；代用品；代理人；代理权§To better understand consumer loyalty to specific online retailers, Peter Štarchon and colleagues created a survey using 58 statements as proxy indicators of customer experience with receiving goods purchased online.§为更好地理解消费者对特定网络零售商的忠诚度，Peter Štarchon 及同事设计了一份问卷，用 58 项陈述作为衡量顾客网购收货体验的**替代性**指标。§Melissa Toups et al. proposed a novel proxy: the evolution of the clothing-exclusive variant of the human-exclusive parasite Pediculus humanus (head lice), which Toups et al. date to as early as 170 Ka.§Melissa Toups 等人提出了一个新颖的**替代指标**：人类专有寄生虫（头虱）之「衣物专有变种」的演化——Toups 等人将其年代定至最早 17 万年前。§§proxy indicator 替代性指标；by proxy 由他人代理§§

30746§metaphor§ˈmetəfə§n. 隐喻；暗喻；象征§Wole Soyinka’s prose poem “Chimes of Silence” challenges the notion that prose poetry—a hybrid form that blends prose formatting with metaphors and other traditional poetic devices—ought to be contained within a single page.§沃莱·索因卡的散文诗《寂静的钟声》挑战了这样一种观念：散文诗——一种把散文排版与**隐喻**等传统诗歌手法相融合的混合形式——应当被限制在一页之内。§Poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the language of the Aztec Empire, relies on difrasismo, or a parallel noun construction that conventionally operates as a single metaphor.§古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的语言）诗歌依赖 difrasismo——一种习惯上作为单一**隐喻**运作的平行名词结构。§§metaphorical adj. 隐喻的；比喻的§与 simile（明喻，用 like/as）不同：metaphor 是直接替换§

30747§patron§ˈpeɪtrən§n. 赞助人；资助者；（商店等的）老主顾§Whether resigned or not to the verdict of the public, he ceased to write plays and assumed instead the nobler role of patron to unrecognized authors and artists and to ruined managers.§无论他是否接受了公众的裁决，他都不再写剧本，转而承担起更崇高的角色：为未获赏识的作家、艺术家以及破产的剧团经理充当**赞助人**。§§§§the role of patron 赞助人的角色；patronage n. 赞助；资助§与 customer（顾客）不同：patron 含「庇护、扶持」意味；patronize 既指「光顾」，也指「居高临下地对待」§

30748§quantitative§ˈkwɒntɪtətɪv§adj. 定量的；数量的；量化的§Focusing on two characteristics that are positive indices of grammatical complexity, fusion (when new phonemes arise from the merger of previously distinct ones) and informativity (languages' capacity for meaningful variation), Olena Shcherbakova and colleagues conducted a quantitative analysis for more than 1,300 languages and claim the outcome is inconsistent with the LNH.§Olena Shcherbakova 及同事聚焦于两项标志语法复杂度的正向指标——融合（新音素由原本相异的音素合并而生）与信息性（语言产生有意义变体的能力）——对 1300 多种语言做了**定量**分析，并声称结果与语言生态位假说不符。§Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.§远读，即对海量数字化文本的计算机辅助**定量**分析，能够揭示此前无人察觉的风格要素，尽管这些要素为现代主义时期的众多文本所共有。§§quantitative analysis 定量分析；quantity n. 数量§与 qualitative（定性的）相对§改例句2：删去混入的 Text 1 末句和「Text 2」标签，译文2 相应删去前半

30749§solitary§ˈsɒlətri§adj. 独居的；独自的；孤独的；唯一的§The scenario of a dwarf mongoose engaging in territorial conflict with an outgroup dwarf mongoose illustrates a major dimension of social life across animal species, from the solitary to those with complex sociality: intraspecific contact with perceived outsiders.§一只侏儒獴与外来侏儒獴发生领地冲突的情景，例示了动物物种社会生活的一个重要维度：从**独居**到高度群居，都存在与被视为外来者的同类接触。§§§§solitude n. 独处；孤独§与 lonely（寂寞的）不同：solitary 是客观状态，不含情绪§

30750§singular§ˈsɪŋɡjələ§adj. 独特的；非凡的；单一的；个别的；（语法）单数的§Accounts of American revolutionary history often imply that the US Declaration of Independence (published in 1776) was a document that specifically resulted from the presumably exceptional nature of the soon‑to‑be United States—in this interpretation, the Declaration is a singular instrument born from a response to injustice that was intended to announce the birth of a new kind of nation and win foreign allies to that nation’s cause.§关于美国革命史的叙述常常暗示，1776 年发表的《美国独立宣言》是一份文献，专门诞生于即将成形的美国那想必不同寻常的特质——按此解读，《宣言》是为回应不义而诞生的**独特**文书，旨在宣告一个新型国家的诞生，并为这个国家的事业赢得外国盟友。§By focusing on singular individuals and incidents in exhaustive detail, Paul Seaver’s Wellington’s World and other microhistories aim to show how broader phenomena were experienced at a human level.§通过穷尽式地聚焦**个别**个体与事件，Paul Seaver 的《威灵顿的世界》等微观史力求展示宏大现象在人的尺度上是如何被经历的。§§singularity n. 奇特；奇点§与 single 不同：singular 强调「独一无二、罕见」；语法中指单数§改译文：删去前半句英文没有的「独特的」（英文只说 a document）
